scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const srcDir = path.join(__dirname, 'src'); function cleanDir(dir) { try { fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(f => { const filePath = path.join(dir, f); const stat = fs.statSync(filePath); if (stat.isDirectory()) { cleanDir(filePath); } else if (f.endsWith('.js') || f.endsWith('.d.ts') || f.endsWith('.map') || f.endsWith('.tsbuildinfo')) { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } }); } catch(e) {} } cleanDir(srcDir);"
